from tools.object_detection import Object_Detector_Tool
from tools.text_detection import Text_Detector_Tool

object_count = 0

def count_sinks():
    tool = Object_Detector_Tool()
    image_path = "path/to/image.png"

    results = tool.execute(image=image_path, labels=['sink'])
    object_count += len(results[0]["label"])

    sink_count = sum(results[0]["label"].get("sink", 0) for result in results)
    return sink_count

def identify_text():
    tool = Text_Detector_Tool()
    languages = ["en", "de"]
    text_count = len(tool.execute(image="path/to/text.png", languages=languages))

    return text_count

final_result = count_sinks() + identify_text()
final_result
